1	# Foundation Requirements Checklist: P-F000 — Foundation
2	
3	**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of spec.md (and cross-check against plan.md) for
4	the auth flows, session lifecycle, error/Failure taxonomy, and navigation surfaces delivered by
5	P-F000, before `/speckit-tasks` proceeds.
6	**Created**: 2026-10-11
7	**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
8	
9	**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
10	**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
11	**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
12	
13	## Auth Flow Requirements (Login / Sign-up)
14	
15	- [ ] CHK001 - Are client-side validation rules (e.g., password minimum length/format) specified for sign-up and login, or is validation fully deferred to the backend? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, Edge Cases]
16	- [ ] CHK002 - Is the UI distinction (if any) between a retryable failure (timeout/offline) and a non-retryable one (invalid credentials, malformed request) specified — e.g., presence or absence of a retry affordance? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-015]
17	- [ ] CHK003 - Is the mechanism for preventing a duplicate account or duplicate session when the app is backgrounded mid-submission specified (e.g., disabling the submit control, idempotent request handling), or left fully to implementation discretion? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
18	- [ ] CHK004 - Is "Criar conta" mode's toggle behavior (FR-008) specified as preserving or clearing already-entered field values when switching between login and sign-up? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
19	
20	## Session Lifecycle & Expired-Session Overlay
21	
22	- [ ] CHK005 - Is "usable session" (FR-009) defined precisely enough to distinguish it from "valid," "active," or "renewable," so routing logic is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
23	- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec specify what "any related background preparation" (FR-010) during the splash state actually consists of, or is this left undefined? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
24	- [ ] CHK007 - Is it disambiguated whether a second session expiry during overlay dismissal causes the existing overlay to remain displayed throughout, versus being dismissed and then re-shown? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
25	- [ ] CHK008 - Are all elements of "screen state" that must survive the expired-session overlay (FR-013, FR-014, SC-005) enumerated, or is only scroll position given as an example with the rest left to interpretation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, SC-005]
26	- [ ] CHK009 - Is the approximate duration or threshold for the splash state quantified anywhere in the requirements (vs. only as an implementation-level performance target), so "brief" (User Story 3) is testable? [Clarity, Spec User Story 3, §FR-010]
27	- [ ] CHK010 - Is the relationship between silent background renewal (Assumptions) and the expired-session overlay (FR-013) consistent — i.e., is it clear the overlay only appears after silent renewal has already been attempted and failed? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions, §FR-013]
28	
29	## Error / Failure Taxonomy (Either<Failure, T>)
30	
31	- [ ] CHK011 - Does the spec identify where the authoritative, closed set of backend error codes is defined, given FR-004 and the Backend Failure entity assume a fixed taxonomy? [Traceability, Spec §FR-004, Key Entities]
32	- [ ] CHK012 - Is the mapping from each of the backend's documented error codes to a specific user-facing message (or message category) specified, or only the general requirement that "every error condition" produce "a clear, non-crashing message" (FR-015)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
33	- [ ] CHK013 - For each of the four auth-related calls (sign-up, login, refresh, session-check), are the specific failure modes (timeout, malformed/non-retryable, offline) that requirements expect to be exercised explicitly enumerated, or only described generically via Edge Cases? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-004]
34	- [ ] CHK014 - Is "retryable flag" (FR-004) requirement's meaning fully specified — i.e., does the spec state what a screen is expected to do differently when a failure is retryable vs. not, beyond showing a message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
35	
36	## Navigation & Placeholder Screens
37	
38	- [ ] CHK015 - Is the side menu's required destination set (FR-011: Home/Chat, Meus Registros, Configurações) consistent with the Assumptions section's mention of an optional "Planos de Ação" placeholder entry — i.e., is it clear whether that entry's presence or absence affects FR-011's completeness? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Assumptions]
39	- [ ] CHK016 - Is "clearly-labeled placeholder" (FR-012) specified with any concrete criteria (e.g., required label text, required "not yet available" indication), or left entirely to implementation judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
40	- [ ] CHK017 - Does the spec define what happens if a user attempts an action on a placeholder screen (Meus Registros, Configurações) beyond viewing it — e.g., any inert control feedback — or is "no functional behavior" (FR-012) sufficient to cover all such interactions? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012, Edge Cases]
41	- [ ] CHK018 - Is the requirement that the side menu "overlays the current screen without discarding state" (Acceptance Scenario, User Story 4) distinguished clearly from the separate state-preservation requirement for the expired-session overlay (FR-013), so the two mechanisms aren't assumed to share one implementation requirement? [Consistency, Spec User Story 4, §FR-013]
42	
43	## Requirement Completeness & Consistency (Cross-Cutting)
44	
45	- [ ] CHK019 - Is the "if at all" qualifier in FR-016 ("any screen or control belonging to one of them MUST exist only as an inert placeholder, if at all") disambiguated — i.e., does the spec make clear under what condition such a control would legitimately not exist at all? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]
46	- [ ] CHK020 - Are the performance thresholds referenced outside spec.md (e.g., <100ms local reflection, >300ms loading-indicator trigger) reflected as a measurable Success Criterion within spec.md itself, or only documented in plan.md's Technical Context? [Consistency, Gap, Spec Success Criteria]
47	- [ ] CHK021 - Does the spec specify whether the loading indicator required for network calls exceeding a latency threshold applies uniformly to all four auth/session calls, or could some calls be exempt? [Gap, Spec Success Criteria]
48	- [ ] CHK022 - Is SC-006 ("zero visual values defined outside the single central source") paired with any requirement for how this is verified (e.g., review process, lint rule), or is verifiability left unaddressed? [Measurability, Spec SC-006]
49	
50	## Dependencies & Assumptions
51	
52	- [ ] CHK023 - Is the assumption that RF03 (biometric/PIN) "is built immediately after this one" validated as a hard dependency, or could delivery-order changes invalidate the routing behavior specified in Assumptions (splash → login/sign-up directly, overlay → login directly)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
53	- [ ] CHK024 - Is the assumption that "every error this unit's calls can return is one of the backend's fixed, documented error codes" validated against an actual enumerated list, or merely asserted without a cross-reference? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
54	- [ ] CHK025 - Is the choice of on-device token storage mechanism explicitly scoped as non-normative ("an implementation choice, not fixed by this specification," per Assumptions) consistent with FR-009's requirement that a session "already exists" between launches — i.e., does the spec avoid implying any particular storage guarantee (e.g., survival across app reinstall) that isn't actually required? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions, §FR-009]
55	
56	## Notes
57	
58	- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
59	- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
60	- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
61	- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
62	- Add comments or findings inline
63	- Link to relevant resources or documentation
64	- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

486	Task: "bloc_test for AuthBloc login flow in test/features/auth/presentation/bloc/auth_bloc_test.dart"

493	---
494	
495	## Implementation Strategy
496	
497	### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)
498	
499	1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
500	2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (blocks every story).
501	3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1 (login → Home/Chat).
502	4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: run T017–T020's tests, then quickstart.md scenario 1 manually.
503	5. Demo on a simulator if ready.
504	
505	### Incremental Delivery
506	
507	1. Setup + Foundational → foundation ready.
508	2. US1 (login) → test independently → demo (MVP).
509	3. US2 (sign-up) → test independently → demo.
510	4. US3 (splash/launch routing) → test independently → demo.
511	5. US4 (side-menu navigation) → test independently → demo.
512	6. US5 (session-expired overlay) → test independently → demo.
513	7. Phase 8 (Polish) → confirm RNF06/07/08/09 gates and run quickstart.md in full.
514	
515	### Parallel Team Strategy
516	
517	1. Team completes Setup + Foundational together (T001–T016).
518	2. Once Foundational is done, US1 should be finished first (US2, US4, and US5 all extend files US1
519	   creates). After US1:

521	   - Developer B: US3 (splash/routing — independent of US1/US2's files).

# Tasks: P-F000 — Foundation

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/001-foundation/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md, spec.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ (http-client.md,
failure-taxonomy.md, auth-repository.md, session-repository.md), quickstart.md — all present.

**Tests**: Included. `plan.md`'s Constitution Check marks RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) as
"PASS (gate carried into tasks)" and RNF09 requires 15/15 write-endpoint failure scenarios covered
by `mocktail`; `quickstart.md`'s Automated checks run `flutter test --coverage` against a
`lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter. Domain-layer unit tests (`mocktail`) and bloc tests (`bloc_test`)
are therefore generated per story; User Story 4 (pure navigation/presentation, no domain code) has
none, matching the domain-only scope of the gate.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story (P1–P5 from spec.md) to enable independent
implementation and testing of each story.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: US1–US5, mapping to spec.md's five user stories
- Exact file paths are given per plan.md's Project Structure

## Path Conventions

Single Flutter app at the repo root: `lib/`, `test/` (plan.md Project Structure; no
`backend/`/`api/` tree — the backend is frozen and consumed only through `docs/input/backend/`).

---

## Phase 1: Setup (Shared Infrastructure)

**Purpose**: Create the Flutter project itself; nothing in `lib/` exists yet in this repo.

- [ ] T001 Run `fvm install 3.47.5` (if not already the cached default) and `fvm use 3.47.5` at the
  repo root, writing `.fvmrc`; then `fvm flutter create .` to scaffold the Flutter project in place
  (iOS platform only — remove/ignore the android/, web/, etc. platform folders `flutter create`
  generates, per plan.md Target Platform: "iOS, portrait orientation only") (research.md R1)
- [ ] T002 Add to `pubspec.yaml` dependencies: `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `dio`, `go_router`,
  `get_it`, `flutter_secure_storage`, `equatable`, `flutter_dotenv` (the last is this task's own
  reasonable choice for loading the repo-root `.env`'s `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`/`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`,
  per Constitution Principle I — the stack list leaves env loading unfixed); dev dependencies:
  `mocktail`, `bloc_test` (plan.md Technical Context, Constitution Principle II)
- [ ] T003 [P] Configure `analysis_options.yaml` with the standard Flutter lint set plus
  `avoid_relative_lib_imports`/import-ordering rules that make a `package:flutter` or `data/` import
  inside any `domain/` folder a visible lint failure (supports RNF06's "0 layer violations" gate,
  checked at Polish phase by `flutter analyze`)
- [ ] T004 [P] Obtain and vendor the Fraunces, Karla, and IBM Plex Mono font files under
  `assets/fonts/`, and declare them under `flutter: fonts:` in `pubspec.yaml` with the weights used
  by `design_tokens.dart` (600 for Fraunces, 400/500/700 for Karla, 500 for IBM Plex Mono) — bundled
  as local assets, not `google_fonts`, per research.md R9

**Checkpoint**: `fvm flutter pub get` succeeds; project scaffold exists.

---

## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)

**Purpose**: The design-token source, the `Either<Failure, T>` network stack, secure storage,
routing skeleton, and DI wiring that every user story below depends on.

**⚠️ CRITICAL**: No user story work can begin until this phase is complete.

- [ ] T005 [P] Create `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`: 14 panel colors (`colorPrimary #1F3D34`,
  `colorPrimaryPressed #16281F`, `colorOnPrimary #F5F1E8`, `colorAccent #C98A3E`,
  `colorOnAccent #241C0D`, `colorSecondary #7C8B6F`, `colorSurfaceBg #F2EFE7`,

## Dependencies & Execution Order

### Phase Dependencies

- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies — start immediately.
- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup — BLOCKS all user stories.
- **User Stories (Phase 3–7)**: All depend on Foundational completion.
  - US1 (P1) has no dependency on another story.
  - US2 (P2) extends US1's `auth_remote_data_source.dart`/`auth_repository_impl.dart`/`auth_bloc.dart`/
    `login_signup_page.dart` in place — do US1 first.
  - US3 (P3) is independent of US1/US2's files but its splash routes to the Home/Chat page US1
    creates (T028) — do US1 first for a meaningful manual test, though US3's own tasks touch no
    US1/US2 files.
  - US4 (P4) extends US1's `home_chat_shell_page.dart` (T028) — do US1 first.

- Tests are written first and MUST fail before their matching implementation task.
- Domain entities/interfaces before use cases; use cases before blocs; blocs before pages.

  `service_locator.dart` registration task that wires them in.

- All Setup tasks marked [P] (T003, T004) can run in parallel once T001/T002 finish.
- Within Foundational, T005, T007, T009, T011 (and the chain T012→T013) can run in parallel; T006,
  T008, T010 each wait only on their own listed dependency.

  a file an earlier story's task already created (e.g. T031/T032/T033, T034/T035/T037/T038) are not

- US4's tasks (T051–T055) can start as soon as Foundational and US1 (for `home_chat_shell_page.dart`)
  are done, in parallel with US2/US3 work by a different contributor.

```bash

Task: "Unit test LoginUseCase in test/features/auth/domain/usecases/login_usecase_test.dart"
Task: "Unit test AuthRepositoryImpl.login in test/features/auth/data/auth_repository_impl_test.dart"
Task: "Unit test AuthRemoteDataSource.login in test/features/auth/data/auth_remote_data_source_test.dart"
Task: "bloc_test for AuthBloc login flow in test/features/auth/presentation/bloc/auth_bloc_test.dart"
```

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First (User Story 1 Only)

1. Complete Phase 1: Setup.
2. Complete Phase 2: Foundational (blocks every story).
3. Complete Phase 3: User Story 1 (login → Home/Chat).
4. **STOP and VALIDATE**: run T017–T020's tests, then quickstart.md scenario 1 manually.
5. Demo on a simulator if ready.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Setup + Foundational → foundation ready.
2. US1 (login) → test independently → demo (MVP).
3. US2 (sign-up) → test independently → demo.
4. US3 (splash/launch routing) → test independently → demo.
5. US4 (side-menu navigation) → test independently → demo.
6. US5 (session-expired overlay) → test independently → demo.
7. Phase 8 (Polish) → confirm RNF06/07/08/09 gates and run quickstart.md in full.

### Parallel Team Strategy

1. Team completes Setup + Foundational together (T001–T016).
2. Once Foundational is done, US1 should be finished first (US2, US4, and US5 all extend files US1
   creates). After US1:
   - Developer A: US2 (sign-up, extends US1's auth files).
   - Developer B: US3 (splash/routing — independent of US1/US2's files).
   - Developer C: US4 (side menu — extends US1's Home/Chat page) once US1's T028 lands.

1	# Research: P-F000 — Foundation
2	
3	Every item below was a "NEEDS CLARIFICATION" or a constitution-flagged "free" choice (routing, HTTP
4	client, local cache, DI, secure storage, biometrics, charting). Biometrics and charting are not
5	exercised by F000, so they are left open for the units that need them (RF03, RF09).
6	
7	## R1 — Flutter/Dart version to pin via `fvm`
8	
9	- **Decision**: Pin this project to Flutter `3.47.5` / Dart `3.13.4`, stable channel.
10	- **Rationale**: The constitution fixes "Flutter and Dart at the version pinned via `fvm`" but no
11	  `.fvmrc` exists yet in this repo — F000 is where the pin is created. `fvm list` on this machine
12	  already shows `3.47.5`/stable cached as the global default (released 2026-09-18), avoiding a
13	  fresh multi-GB download and giving a reproducible, already-verified SDK.
14	- **Alternatives considered**: Pinning an older LTS-style version — rejected, no such version is
15	  already available locally and the constitution expresses no preference for anything but
16	  "the version pinned via fvm," which this satisfies directly.
17	
18	## R2 — HTTP client
19	
20	- **Decision**: `dio`.
21	- **Rationale**: FR-003/FR-004 require one call surface that always yields `Either<Failure, T>`
22	  and uniformly translates `{code, message, retryable, requestId}` into a typed failure; Principle
23	  III requires injecting `apikey` and the right `Authorization` value per call. `dio`'s
24	  `Interceptor` API is the natural place to inject both headers once and to centralize
25	  timeout/malformed/offline detection for every later unit's write endpoints (RNF09), rather than
26	  repeating that logic per repository.
27	- **Alternatives considered**: `package:http` — would need a hand-rolled interceptor-equivalent
28	  layer for header injection and timeout classification, duplicating what `dio` gives for free;
29	  rejected as unnecessary extra surface for no benefit given `dio` is already the de-facto standard
30	  paired with `flutter_bloc` + `fpdart` repositories.
31	
32	## R3 — Routing and the two "overlay" requirements (side menu, Sessão expirada)
33	
34	- **Decision**: `go_router` for top-level screen navigation, with a single root `Navigator` stack
35	  (`context.push`, not `go`/`replace`, from the side menu). The side menu itself is a plain
36	  `Scaffold.drawer` (`Drawer` widget), not a route. The "Sessão expirada" overlay is a
37	  non-dismissible `showDialog` raised through a root `navigatorKey` whenever `SessionBloc` observes
38	  an `AUTH_EXPIRED` failure that silent refresh could not resolve.
39	- **Rationale**: FR-013/FR-014 and User Story 5 require the screen underneath the overlay to keep
40	  its exact state (e.g., scroll position). Flutter never disposes a `State` object that is merely
41	  covered by a drawer or by a dialog route pushed on top of it — only `push`ing (not `go`/replacing)
42	  guarantees this for screen-to-screen navigation too (FR-011, User Story 4: "returning to
43	  Home/Chat, confirming Home/Chat's state unchanged"). This reaches both behaviors without a
44	  nested/branch-navigation scheme.
45	- **Alternatives considered**: `StatefulShellRoute` (go_router's persistent-tab branches) — gives
46	  the same state-preservation guarantee but is built for bottom-nav-style parallel branches; Meus
47	  Registros/Configurações are occasional side-menu destinations, not a tab bar, so plain stack
48	  `push` is the simpler fit. A hand-built `Overlay`/`OverlayEntry` for the expired-session case was

50	  scrim, matching the prototype's "centered card over a light scrim" description with less custom
51	  code.

54

57	  repositories, two blocs-as-factories). `get_it` is the standard pairing with `flutter_bloc` for
58	  exposing repositories/use cases to `BlocProvider`s without threading them through constructors
59	  manually, and manual registration avoids adding a build-time code-gen dependency for a graph this
60	  small.

62	  premature; the registration list is small enough that generated code would add build complexity
63	  without a proportional benefit. Can be introduced later without touching domain code if the
64	  graph grows.

68	- **Decision**: `flutter_secure_storage`.

70	  app ships iOS-only, where `flutter_secure_storage` backs onto the Keychain — appropriate for
71	  credentials, unlike unencrypted `shared_preferences`.
72	- **Alternatives considered**: `shared_preferences` — rejected, stores in plaintext and is
73	  unsuitable for refresh tokens even on a single-platform (iOS) app.
74

76	
77	- **Decision**: `core/network/failure.dart` models all 13 closed error codes from
78	  `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` now, even though F000's own 4 endpoints can only return a
79	  subset of them.
80	- **Rationale**: FR-004 says the system must translate "every backend error response['s] error
81	  code" — worded generically, not scoped to F000's own calls — and this file is exactly the shared
82	  piece "no single requirement owns but all of them use" that requirements.md §12 assigns to F000.
83	  Defining it once now means RF01–RF09 never need to touch this file, only add usages of it.
84	- **Alternatives considered**: Mapping only the codes F000's endpoints can return (`AUTH_EXPIRED`,
85	  `AUTH_INVALID`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`, `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RATE_LIMITED`) and
86	  letting later units extend the hierarchy — rejected: the taxonomy is explicitly closed and fully
87	  known today, so extending it later would be a pure mechanical addition with no new information,
88	  while leaving it incomplete risks a later unit quietly handling an "unknown" code path instead of
89	  its real typed `Failure`.
90	
91	## R7 — Splash-time session check under a network failure
92	
93	- **Decision**: If `GET auth-session` (or the subsequent `POST auth-refresh` fallback) itself fails
94	  with `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` or `NETWORK_OFFLINE` — as opposed to resolving to `AUTH_EXPIRED`/
95	  `AUTH_INVALID` — the splash screen shows its connectivity-aware state with a manual retry action,
96	  rather than routing straight to the login screen.
97	- **Rationale**: Spec.md's edge cases and FR-010 require the splash to never leave the user "stuck"
98	  and User Story 3 only specifies the valid/expired-renewable/none outcomes — a transient network
99	  failure is a fourth, unspecified case. Routing straight to login would be actively wrong for a
100	  user who does have a valid stored session but is momentarily offline; silently retrying forever
101	  would leave them stuck. A visible retry affordance satisfies "never stuck" without discarding a
102	  potentially-valid session. This is the reasonable technical decision Constitution Principle I
103	  calls for where the inputs are silent.
104	- **Alternatives considered**: Auto-retry with exponential backoff and no user action — rejected,
105	  can still leave the user staring at the splash indefinitely on sustained offline, which the spec's
106	  edge cases explicitly want to avoid.
107

109

111	  override it.
112	- **Rationale**: Neither requirements.md nor the constitution states a minimum iOS version — only
113	  "iOS, portrait only." Inventing a specific floor (e.g., "iOS 15+") would be an unrequested,
114	  unverifiable constraint. The SDK's own default is the reasonable technical decision here per
115	  Constitution Principle I.
116	- **Alternatives considered**: None — there is no documented requirement to weigh against.
117

119	
120	- **Decision**: A plain Dart class of `static const` values (colors as `Color`, type scale as
121	  `TextStyle`, spacing/radii as `double`) feeding a single `ThemeData` built from those constants;
122	  fonts (`Fraunces`, `Karla`, `IBM Plex Mono`) are bundled as local assets declared in
123	  `pubspec.yaml`, not fetched at runtime.

125	  const` class makes any other hardcoded value a compile-time-visible outlier (not referencing the
126	  token file) rather than something only caught by review. Bundling fonts as assets (vs.
127	  `google_fonts`, which fetches over the network on first use) avoids adding a second runtime
128	  network dependency beyond the backend itself and keeps text rendering deterministic offline,
129	  consistent with RNF01's latency intent.
130	- **Alternatives considered**: `google_fonts` package — rejected: introduces a non-backend network
131	  fetch and a cache-miss failure mode (slow/no connection on first launch) that bundled assets don't
132	  have. Obtaining and vendoring the three actual font files is left as an implementation task
133	  (tasks.md), since this plan does not fetch external binary assets.

136	
137	- **Decision**: The Home/Chat screen F000 ships shows the fixed header (☰ + "Cerne" wordmark per
138	  the prototype) and an empty conversation area, plus a composer bar that is rendered but fully
139	  **disabled** (text field non-editable, send button non-interactive) — no fake messages, no RF04
140	  wiring.
141	- **Rationale**: FR-016 allows RF01–RF10 controls to "exist only as an inert placeholder, if at
142	  all." Showing the chrome disabled (rather than omitting it) keeps the screen visually faithful to

144	  Home/Chat) without implementing any chat behavior; disabling it (rather than wiring a no-op
145	  handler) makes the "inert" property visible to a reviewer and to a user, not just true in code.
146	- **Alternatives considered**: Omitting the composer entirely and showing only an empty state —
147	  rejected: the chat's own BLoC/scroll-state is what User Story 5's expired-session test needs to
148	  observe being preserved; a composer absent today would have to be added back by the RF04 unit in
149	  a way that reshapes this same screen, whereas a disabled composer is forward-compatible (RF04
150	  only needs to enable it).

  `.fvmrc` exists yet in this repo — F000 is where the pin is created. `fvm list` on this machine
  already shows `3.47.5`/stable cached as the global default (released 2026-09-18), avoiding a
  fresh multi-GB download and giving a reproducible, already-verified SDK.

  already available locally and the constitution expresses no preference for anything but

  repeating that logic per repository.

  paired with `flutter_bloc` + `fpdart` repositories.

# Quickstart: validating P-F000 — Foundation

Prerequisites, run commands, and expected outcomes for proving this unit's 5 user stories end to
end. Interface details (headers, URLs, failure types) are in `contracts/`; entity/state details
are in `data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- `fvm use 3.47.5` run once at the repo root (installs/links the pinned SDK — see research.md R1).
- `.env` present at the repo root with `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` (already exists
  in this repo; never commit it).
- `fvm flutter pub get`.
- A real or simulated iOS device/runner (`fvm flutter devices`), since the target platform is iOS.

## Setup

```bash
fvm flutter pub get
fvm flutter run -d <ios-device-or-simulator-id>
```

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                   # 0 issues, incl. no flutter imports under domain/ (RNF06)
fvm flutter test --coverage                            # unit + bloc tests (mocktail, bloc_test)
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/*/domain/*' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain_html    # inspect: >= 80% (RNF07)
```

## Manual / integration validation scenarios

Each maps directly to a spec.md Acceptance Scenario.

1. **Login (User Story 1)**
   - Launch with no stored session → login screen.
   - Enter a valid, existing email/password → lands on Home/Chat.
   - Enter a wrong password → inline, non-crashing error, stays on login screen, can retry.
   - Turn off network, submit → retryable connection-error message, no hang/crash.

2. **Sign-up (User Story 2)**
   - From the login screen, tap the toggle link → title/CTA switch to "Criar conta" (same screen,
     no navigation).
   - Submit a brand-new email/password → account created, lands directly on Home/Chat.
   - Submit an already-registered email → clear error, form stays editable, no crash.

3. **Launch routing (User Story 3)** — exercise all three stored-session conditions:
   - Valid session on device → splash, then straight to Home/Chat, no credentials re-entered.
   - No stored session (fresh install, or after a manual token wipe) → splash, then login screen.
   - Expired-but-refreshable session (manually expire the stored `accessToken`, keep a valid
     `refreshToken`) → splash, silent `auth-refresh`, lands on Home/Chat without any prompt.

4. **Base navigation (User Story 4)** — confirms SC-004 (≤2 taps each way)
   - From Home/Chat, tap ☰ (1 tap) → drawer opens, see Meus Registros, Configurações.
   - Tap Meus Registros (2 taps total) → visible; tap ☰ then Home/Chat (≤2 taps) to return →
     chat shell state (e.g., scroll position) unchanged.
   - Repeat for Configurações, confirming ≤2 taps each direction.
   - Opening the drawer itself visibly scrims the current screen without resetting it.

5. **Session-expired overlay (User Story 5)**
   - Get to a known state on a screen (e.g., scroll Home/Chat partway).
   - Force a session-expired response (e.g., revoke/expire the access token server-side, or stub it
     in a debug build) while that screen is active.
   - Confirm the "Sessão expirada" card appears over a light scrim, screen content still visible
     and unchanged underneath.
   - Tap "Entrar novamente", re-authenticate → overlay dismissed, screen state (scroll position)
     restored exactly.
   - Repeat the forced expiry while the overlay is still visible (before dismissing) → overlay
     persists/reappears rather than letting the user proceed.

## Expected outcome

All 5 scenarios above pass; `flutter analyze` and `flutter test --coverage` are clean; the
`lib/**/domain/**` coverage report meets RNF07; no screen's rendered output uses a color, font, or
spacing value traceable to anything other than `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (spot-check via code
review, since this is not yet an automated lint in this unit).

# Contract: `ApiClient` (`lib/core/network/api_client.dart`)

The single way any feature calls the backend (FR-003). Every later unit's `data/` layer depends on
this, never on `dio` directly.

## Construction

```dart
class ApiClient {
  ApiClient({required Dio dio, required SecureTokenStorage tokenStorage, required String anonKey});

  Future<Either<Failure, Map<String, dynamic>>> call(
    String function, {               // e.g. "auth-login" — never a REST path (FR-005)
    required String method,          // "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE"
    Map<String, dynamic>? body,
    List<String>? pathSegments,      // appended in the order the OpenAPI path declares them
    AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession, // or AuthMode.anonKey
  });
}

enum AuthMode { anonKey, userSession }
```

## Behavior

1. **URL construction**: `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>/<pathSegments...>` — read from `.env`'s
   `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`. Never the OpenAPI document's REST-notation path (Principle III, FR-005).
2. **Headers, every call**: `apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>` (from `.env`).
3. **`Authorization` header**:
   - `AuthMode.anonKey` → `Bearer <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>` — used for `auth-signup`, `auth-login`,
     `auth-refresh` (no user session exists yet or is being replaced).
   - `AuthMode.userSession` → `Bearer <stored accessToken>` (read from `SecureTokenStorage`) — used
     for `auth-session` and every `bearerAuth` operation added by later units.
4. **Success**: returns `Right(data)` where `data` is the parsed `data` object from the response
   envelope (`{data, meta}`), discarding `meta` unless a future unit's contract says otherwise.
5. **Failure**: any non-2xx response with the `{code, message, retryable, requestId}` error body is
   passed to `ErrorMapper.fromResponse(...)` → `Left(Failure)` (see `failure-taxonomy.md`). A dio
   `DioExceptionType.connectionError`/no-response condition is mapped directly to
   `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure(...))` without a parse attempt (error-taxonomy.md: `NETWORK_OFFLINE`
   never arrives as an HTTP response). A dio timeout is mapped to `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure(...))`.
6. **Never throws** past this boundary — every exception dio can raise is caught and mapped to a
   `Failure` before returning, satisfying FR-003 ("never an unhandled crash").

## Who depends on this

`AuthRemoteDataSource`, `SessionRemoteDataSource` (this unit) and every later unit's `*RemoteDataSource`.

1	# Contract: `SessionRepository` (`lib/features/session/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`)
2	
3	Domain-layer interface owning the session lifecycle: launch-time check, silent refresh, and
4	reading/clearing the stored session. `SessionBloc` depends on this and on nothing in
5	`session/data/` or `auth/data/` directly (RNF06).
6	
7	```dart
8	abstract class SessionRepository {
9	  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> checkSession();     // GET auth-session, using the stored accessToken
10	  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> refresh();           // POST auth-refresh, using the stored refreshToken
11	  Future<void> persist(Session session);                 // write-through to SecureTokenStorage
12	  Future<void> clear();                                   // logout / failed-refresh cleanup
13	  Future<bool> hasStoredSession();                        // true iff a refreshToken is present on device
14	}
15	```
16	
17	- **`checkSession`** → FR-009's first step. `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` is the expected, non-error
18	  trigger for the caller (`CheckSessionUseCase`) to then call `refresh()` — not itself a terminal
19	  failure shown to the user.
20	- **`refresh`** → FR-009's renewal step, also reused for the silent-refresh-before-overlay path of
21	  FR-013 (User Story 5) and for any later unit's authenticated call that comes back
22	  `AUTH_EXPIRED`. On `Right`, calls `persist()` internally before returning.
23	- **`persist`/`clear`** → thin wrappers over `SecureTokenStorage`; exposed on the repository (not
24	  the data source) so the domain layer's use cases never import `storage/` directly.
25	- **`hasStoredSession`** → lets `CheckSessionUseCase` skip the network call entirely when there is
26	  nothing to check (Edge Cases / User Story 3 scenario 2: no stored session → straight to login,
27	  no call made).
28	
29	## `CheckSessionUseCase` (orchestration, domain layer)
30	
31	```dart
32	Future<SessionStatus> call() async {
33	  if (!await repo.hasStoredSession()) return SessionStatus.unauthenticated;
34	  final checked = await repo.checkSession();
35	  return checked.match(
36	    (failure) => failure is AuthExpiredFailure
37	        ? _tryRefresh()
38	        : SessionStatus.networkError(failure),      // R7 — splash retry affordance, not a route change
39	    (session) => SessionStatus.authenticated(session),
40	  );
41	}
42	
43	Future<SessionStatus> _tryRefresh() async {
44	  final refreshed = await repo.refresh();
45	  return refreshed.match(
46	    (failure) async { await repo.clear(); return SessionStatus.unauthenticated; },
47	    (session) => SessionStatus.authenticated(session),
48	  );
49	}
50	```
51	
52	This single use case is what `SplashPage`/`SessionBloc` calls — it is the only place FR-009's
53	"renew first, then route" rule is implemented, so later units never re-derive it.
54	
55	## Who depends on this
56	
57	`SessionBloc` (splash routing, FR-010; expired-session overlay trigger, FR-013/FR-014). Every later
58	unit that makes an authenticated call and receives `AuthExpiredFailure` calls `SessionRepository
59	.refresh()` the same way, through this interface — never by re-implementing the refresh call.
60

1	# Contract: `AuthRepository` (`lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart`)
2	
3	Domain-layer interface; `AuthBloc` (presentation) depends on this and on nothing in `auth/data/`
4	directly (RNF06).
5	
6	```dart
7	abstract class AuthRepository {
8	  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> signUp({required String email, required String password});
9	  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> login({required String email, required String password});
10	}
11	```

14	  persists the returned `Session` via `SecureTokenStorage` before the bloc emits its authenticated
15	  state — sign-up and login leave the app in an identical post-condition (spec.md User Story 2).
16	- **`login`** → calls `auth-login` (`AuthMode.anonKey`). Maps to FR-007. Same persistence step.
17	- Both return `Left(ValidationFailure)` for a malformed submission, `Left(AuthInvalidFailure)` for
18	  wrong credentials / already-registered email, `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` /
19	  `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` for connectivity problems — never a thrown exception (FR-003).
20	- Empty-field submissions never reach this interface at all — the presentation layer validates and
21	  blocks the call before invoking it (Edge Cases: "no network call made").

23	## Use cases wrapping this repository

26	  as separate classes (not inlined into the bloc) so later units' tests and the domain-coverage
27	  gate (RNF07) have a single, directly-testable unit per operation, independent of bloc wiring.

29	## Who depends on this

31	`AuthBloc` only, in this unit. The interface is intentionally narrow (no `logout`, no
32	`refresh` — those belong to `SessionRepository` below, since they are session-lifecycle concerns
33	rather than "an account submits credentials") — this keeps the boundary RF10's note about "a shared

# Contract: `AuthRepository` (`lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart`)

Domain-layer interface; `AuthBloc` (presentation) depends on this and on nothing in `auth/data/`
directly (RNF06).

```dart
abstract class AuthRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> signUp({required String email, required String password});
  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> login({required String email, required String password});
}
```

- **`signUp`** → calls `auth-signup` (`AuthMode.anonKey`). Maps to FR-006. On `Right`, the use case
  persists the returned `Session` via `SecureTokenStorage` before the bloc emits its authenticated
  state — sign-up and login leave the app in an identical post-condition (spec.md User Story 2).
- **`login`** → calls `auth-login` (`AuthMode.anonKey`). Maps to FR-007. Same persistence step.
- Both return `Left(ValidationFailure)` for a malformed submission, `Left(AuthInvalidFailure)` for
  wrong credentials / already-registered email, `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` /
  `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` for connectivity problems — never a thrown exception (FR-003).
- Empty-field submissions never reach this interface at all — the presentation layer validates and
  blocks the call before invoking it (Edge Cases: "no network call made").

## Use cases wrapping this repository

- `SignUpUseCase(AuthRepository)` / `LoginUseCase(AuthRepository)` — thin pass-throughs today, kept
  as separate classes (not inlined into the bloc) so later units' tests and the domain-coverage
  gate (RNF07) have a single, directly-testable unit per operation, independent of bloc wiring.

## Who depends on this

`AuthBloc` only, in this unit. The interface is intentionally narrow (no `logout`, no
`refresh` — those belong to `SessionRepository` below, since they are session-lifecycle concerns
rather than "an account submits credentials") — this keeps the boundary RF10's note about "a shared
interface / use case, never a directly imported repository" generalizes to: every feature talks to
auth/session through these two interfaces, never through each other's `data/` classes.

name: cerne
description: "A new Flutter project."
# The following line prevents the package from being accidentally published to
# pub.dev using `flutter pub publish`. This is preferred for private packages.
publish_to: 'none' # Remove this line if you wish to publish to pub.dev

# The following defines the version and build number for your application.
# A version number is three numbers separated by dots, like 1.2.43
# followed by an optional build number separated by a +.
# Both the version and the builder number may be overridden in flutter
# build by specifying --build-name and --build-number, respectively.
# In Android, build-name is used as versionName while build-number used as versionCode.
# Read more about Android versioning at https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/versioning
# In iOS, build-name is used as CFBundleShortVersionString while build-number is used as CFBundleVersion.
# Read more about iOS versioning at
# https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Reference/InfoPlistKeyReference/Articles/CoreFoundationKeys.html
# In Windows, build-name is used as the major, minor, and patch parts
# of the product and file versions while build-number is used as the build suffix.
version: 1.0.0+1

environment:
  sdk: ^3.13.4

# Dependencies specify other packages that your package needs in order to work.
# To automatically upgrade your package dependencies to the latest versions
# consider running `flutter pub upgrade --major-versions`. Alternatively,
# dependencies can be manually updated by changing the version numbers below to
# the latest version available on pub.dev. To see which dependencies have newer
# versions available, run `flutter pub outdated`.
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter

  # The following adds the Cupertino Icons font to your application.
  # Use with the CupertinoIcons class for iOS style icons.
  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8

dev_dependencies:
  flutter_test:
    sdk: flutter

  # The "flutter_lints" package below contains a set of recommended lints to
  # encourage good coding practices. The lint set provided by the package is
  # activated in the `analysis_options.yaml` file located at the root of your
  # package. See that file for information about deactivating specific lint
  # rules and activating additional ones.
  flutter_lints: ^6.0.0

# For information on the generic Dart part of this file, see the
# following page: https://dart.dev/tools/pub/pubspec

# The following section is specific to Flutter packages.
flutter:

  # The following line ensures that the Material Icons font is
  # included with your application, so that you can use the icons in
  # the material Icons class.
  uses-material-design: true

  # To add assets to your application, add an assets section, like this:
  # assets:
  #   - images/a_dot_burr.jpeg
  #   - images/a_dot_ham.jpeg

  # An image asset can refer to one or more resolution-specific "variants", see
  # https://flutter.dev/to/resolution-aware-images

  # For details regarding adding assets from package dependencies, see
  # https://flutter.dev/to/asset-from-package

  # To add custom fonts to your application, add a fonts section here,
  # in this "flutter" section. Each entry in this list should have a
  # "family" key with the font family name, and a "fonts" key with a
  # list giving the asset and other descriptors for the font. For
  # example:
  # fonts:
  #   - family: Schyler

  # For details regarding fonts from package dependencies,

# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

```
Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat

Home/Chat (base screen)
  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)

Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period

Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

## 2. Navigable states

Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.

### 2.1 Entry and authentication
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |

### 2.2 Conversation
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 1 — Home/Chat (default) | Messages going back and forth; dark green fixed header with ☰ and wordmark; composer with "+", placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...", send icon. |
| Tela 1 — Streaming | AI response revealed progressively with a pulsing cursor. |
| Tela 1 — Insight | Insight card with ochre spine, label "INSIGHT", "x" to dismiss, interleaved in the messages. |
| Tela 1 — Falha ao gerar resposta | Incomplete AI message with "Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente" in red, in place of the time. |
| Tela 1 — Bookmark | Bookmark on each user message with 4 sub-states: `idle`, `saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning). |
| Tela 1 — Offline | Blue-gray banner "Sem conexão — histórico disponível, novas mensagens bloqueadas"; send icon disabled. |
| Tela 1 — Sessão expirada | Light scrim over the chat (still readable), centered card with lock icon, title "Sessão expirada", text saying history and scroll position are kept, button "Entrar novamente". |
| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |

### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.

| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Texto | Multiline field, placeholder "Escreva livremente...", button "Salvar". |
| Áudio — Gravando | Red stop button, animated 12-bar waveform, monospace timer (e.g., "00:12"). |
| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |

### 2.4 Records
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 4 — Meus Registros (default) | Records grouped by date ("Hoje", "Ontem", dates); each card with a spine colored by origin, source icon, time, sync indicator (green "sincronizado" / ochre "sincronizando" / red "erro de sync"), text excerpt, category chips when present; header with back arrow, title, download icon; search bar "Buscar nos registros..." with a funnel button. |
| Tela 4 — Vazio | Large notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", CTA "Criar primeiro registro". |
| Tela 4 — Filtros ativos | Removable chips under the search bar with the applied filters, link "Limpar filtros"; funnel button filled. |
| Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro | Groups "INTERVALO DE DATA" (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, single choice), "CATEGORIA" (chips: trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações), "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (chips: manual, áudio, foto, chat); "Aplicar" and "Limpar". **Note:** the backend has no category filter (requirements, RF06); categories are the tags extension. |

### 2.5 Export (bottom sheet over Tela 4; 5 states)
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Pendente | Spinner, "Preparando exportação...". |
| Processando | "Gerando resumo com IA...", progress bar. |
| Concluído | Green check, "Resumo pronto", buttons "Baixar PDF" (primary) and "Baixar dados brutos" (outline). |
| Erro | Red warning; text explaining that the AI narrative failed but the data remains available; only the button "Baixar dados brutos". |
| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |

All five have the link "Fechar" at the bottom. The mapping between these states and the backend job statuses is in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`.

### 2.6 Plans and settings
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]** | Three horizontally scrolling columns — "A Fazer", "Em Andamento", "Concluído" — with counts and cards. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — mais de 30 registros | "Sua evolução": 10-bar ochre chart + summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — uma entrada | A single small bar and the text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias." |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — zero entradas | Light-gray chart icon in place of the chart and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; no summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — narrativa indisponível | Chart with data, but the AI summary paragraph failed — needs its own error message, not just missing text. |
| Tela 6 — Confirmar exclusão de conta | Centered dialog, red title "Apagar sua conta?", text on permanent, irreversible deletion; red button "Apagar tudo"; outline "Cancelar". |

Other elements of Configurações: avatar with editable name/e-mail (pencil becomes a check in edit mode — inline editing); persona cards "Como a IA responde" (Analítico, Empático, Socrático) **[ext]**; actions "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (red).

---

## 3. Visual system (tokens for `design_tokens.dart`)

The prototype has a **Design Tokens** panel, marked as the ground truth for `design_tokens.dart`. Its names and values are below.

### Colors
| Token | Hex | Use (as stated in the panel) |
|---|---|---|
| `colorPrimary` | `#1F3D34` | Buttons, app bar, wordmark |
| `colorPrimaryPressed` | `#16281F` | Pressed state |
| `colorOnPrimary` | `#F5F1E8` | Text on primary |
| `colorAccent` | `#C98A3E` | CTA, insight, saved bookmark |
| `colorOnAccent` | `#241C0D` | Text on accent |
| `colorSecondary` | `#7C8B6F` | Tags, chips, synchronizing |
| `colorSurfaceBg` | `#F2EFE7` | General background ("paper") |
| `colorSurfaceElevated` | `#FBF9F4` | Cards, bubbles, sheets |
| `colorBorder` | `#E1DACB` | Dividers, borders |
| `colorTextPrimary` | `#241F19` | Main text |
| `colorTextSecondary` | `#6B6255` | Secondary text |
| `colorError` | `#B3402A` | Errors, destructive action |
| `colorSuccess` | `#4C6B4F` | Synchronized, confirmations |
| `colorWarningSync` | `#C98A3E` | "Synchronizing" badge |
| `colorInfoOffline` | `#5C7A93` | Offline banner — single use |

Other colors that appear on specific screens but not in the panel: user chat bubble `#D9DFD3`; text on category chips `#3F4A38`.

### Typography
| Token | Font · weight · size/line-height | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `textDisplayLg` | Fraunces 600 · 32/38 | Splash wordmark |
| `textHeadlineMd` | Fraunces 600 · 24/30 | Section titles |
| `textTitleLg` | Karla 700 · 20/26 | App bar title |
| `textTitleSm` | Karla 700 · 16/22 | Subtitles |
| `textBodyLg` | Karla 400 · 16/24 | Bubbles, entries |
| `textBodyMd` | Karla 400 · 14/20 | Secondary text and descriptions |
| `textLabelMd` | Karla 500 · 13/18 | Button text, chips |
| `textMonoCaption` | IBM Plex Mono 500 · 12/16 · letter-spacing .2 | Technical metadata (timestamps, counters, status labels) |

### Spacing (4 dp grid)
`spacingXs` 4 · `spacingSm` 8 · `spacingMd` 16 · `spacingLg` 24 · `spacingXl` 32 · `spacing2xl` 48 (dp).

### Radii
`radiusSm` 8 dp (inputs, chips) · `radiusMd` 16 dp (cards, bubbles) · `radiusLg` 24 dp (sheets, modals) · `radiusFull` 999 dp (avatars, pills).

### Elevation
`elevation1` — `0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)` (cards at rest) · `elevation2` — `0 4px 16px rgba(36,31,25,.14)` (sheets, modals).

### Icons
Phosphor library, Regular style, 24 dp: `list`, `plus`, `magnifying-glass`, `funnel`, `bookmark-simple`, `microphone`, `camera`, `gear`, `kanban`, `notebook`, `fingerprint`, `lightbulb` (and others used on specific screens: `check`, `warning-circle`, `wifi-slash`, `circle-notch`, `caret-left`, `download-simple`, `pencil-simple`, `x`, `stop`, `image`, `check-circle`, `chart-line-up`, `backspace`, `lock-key`, `paper-plane-tilt`, `chat-circle-text`).

### Spine (colored bar on the left of a card) — 3 contexts
1. Proactive insight in the chat — ochre.
2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.

### Micro-animations and transitions
- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.

---

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

---

## 6. Component library

| Component | Where it appears | Variations |
|---|---|---|
| Primary button | Auth, modals, sheets, confirmations | normal (`#1F3D34`) · pressed (`#16281F`, darker) · disabled (`#E1DACB` background, `#6B6255` text) |
| Secondary button (outline) | "Tentar novamente", "Cancelar", "Baixar dados brutos" | `#1F3D34` outline, no fill |
| Text button (ghost) | Mode-toggle links, "Fechar", "Limpar" | no background, `#1F3D34` or `#6B6255` depending on context |
| Text field | Login, Texto tab, name editing | empty · focused (1.5px `#1F3D34` border) · error (`#B3402A` border) |
| Chat bubble | Home/Chat | user (light green, straight bottom-right corner) · AI (ivory with shadow, straight bottom-left corner) · streaming (pulsing cursor at the end of the text) |
| Insight card | Home/Chat | ochre spine, mono label "INSIGHT", dismiss button |
| Bookmark button (RF10) | User messages in the chat | idle (outline) · saving (spinner) · saved (ochre check) · error (red warning) |
| Send-error banner | Home/Chat | "Não foi possível enviar — toque para tentar novamente"; background `rgba(179,64,42,.08)`, warning icon, red text |
| Offline banner | Home/Chat | blue-gray background `#5C7A93`, `ph-wifi-slash` icon, light text |
| Sync badge | Record cards (Tela 4) | synced (green dot) · synchronizing (ochre dot) · sync error (red dot) |
| Filter chip | Filter sheet, active filters | single choice (date) · multiple choice (category, type) · removable with "x" (active filters) |
| Record card | Tela 4 | spine colored by origin (manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre) |
| Kanban card **[ext]** | Planos de Ação | spine by column (to do / in progress / done) |
| Initials avatar | Side menu, Configurações | dark green circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, two sizes (40px in the menu, 52px in Configurações) |
| AI persona card **[ext]** | Configurações | not selected (thin border) · selected (thick `#1F3D34` border + check icon) |
| Bar chart (dashboard) | Configurações | populated (10 bars) · one bar · empty (placeholder icon) |
| Export status card | Tela 4 (bottom sheet) | pending · processing · done · error · empty |
| Confirmation dialog | Sessão expirada, Confirmar exclusão | background scrim + centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive deletion) |
| PIN keypad | Tela 0.1b/c | digits 0–9 + backspace; progress dots above |
| Tab bar | Insertion modal | 3 tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto), active tab with filled background |
| Audio waveform | Insertion modal, Áudio tab | active/animated (recording) · frozen and faded (processing) |
| Skeleton | Any content loaded over the network | shown for calls longer than 300 ms (RNF01) |

```
Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

## 2. Navigable states

Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.

### 2.1 Entry and authentication
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |

### 2.2 Conversation
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 1 — Home/Chat (default) | Messages going back and forth; dark green fixed header with ☰ and wordmark; composer with "+", placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...", send icon. |
| Tela 1 — Streaming | AI response revealed progressively with a pulsing cursor. |
| Tela 1 — Insight | Insight card with ochre spine, label "INSIGHT", "x" to dismiss, interleaved in the messages. |
| Tela 1 — Falha ao gerar resposta | Incomplete AI message with "Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente" in red, in place of the time. |
| Tela 1 — Bookmark | Bookmark on each user message with 4 sub-states: `idle`, `saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning). |
| Tela 1 — Offline | Blue-gray banner "Sem conexão — histórico disponível, novas mensagens bloqueadas"; send icon disabled. |
| Tela 1 — Sessão expirada | Light scrim over the chat (still readable), centered card with lock icon, title "Sessão expirada", text saying history and scroll position are kept, button "Entrar novamente". |
| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |

### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.

| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Texto | Multiline field, placeholder "Escreva livremente...", button "Salvar". |
| Áudio — Gravando | Red stop button, animated 12-bar waveform, monospace timer (e.g., "00:12"). |
| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |

### 2.4 Records
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 4 — Meus Registros (default) | Records grouped by date ("Hoje", "Ontem", dates); each card with a spine colored by origin, source icon, time, sync indicator (green "sincronizado" / ochre "sincronizando" / red "erro de sync"), text excerpt, category chips when present; header with back arrow, title, download icon; search bar "Buscar nos registros..." with a funnel button. |
| Tela 4 — Vazio | Large notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", CTA "Criar primeiro registro". |
| Tela 4 — Filtros ativos | Removable chips under the search bar with the applied filters, link "Limpar filtros"; funnel button filled. |
| Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro | Groups "INTERVALO DE DATA" (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, single choice), "CATEGORIA" (chips: trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações), "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (chips: manual, áudio, foto, chat); "Aplicar" and "Limpar". **Note:** the backend has no category filter (requirements, RF06); categories are the tags extension. |

### 2.5 Export (bottom sheet over Tela 4; 5 states)
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Pendente | Spinner, "Preparando exportação...". |
| Processando | "Gerando resumo com IA...", progress bar. |
| Concluído | Green check, "Resumo pronto", buttons "Baixar PDF" (primary) and "Baixar dados brutos" (outline). |
| Erro | Red warning; text explaining that the AI narrative failed but the data remains available; only the button "Baixar dados brutos". |
| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |

All five have the link "Fechar" at the bottom. The mapping between these states and the backend job statuses is in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`.

### 2.6 Plans and settings
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]** | Three horizontally scrolling columns — "A Fazer", "Em Andamento", "Concluído" — with counts and cards. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — mais de 30 registros | "Sua evolução": 10-bar ochre chart + summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — uma entrada | A single small bar and the text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias." |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — zero entradas | Light-gray chart icon in place of the chart and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; no summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — narrativa indisponível | Chart with data, but the AI summary paragraph failed — needs its own error message, not just missing text. |
| Tela 6 — Confirmar exclusão de conta | Centered dialog, red title "Apagar sua conta?", text on permanent, irreversible deletion; red button "Apagar tudo"; outline "Cancelar". |

Other elements of Configurações: avatar with editable name/e-mail (pencil becomes a check in edit mode — inline editing); persona cards "Como a IA responde" (Analítico, Empático, Socrático) **[ext]**; actions "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (red).

---

## 3. Visual system (tokens for `design_tokens.dart`)

The prototype has a **Design Tokens** panel, marked as the ground truth for `design_tokens.dart`. Its names and values are below.

### Colors
| Token | Hex | Use (as stated in the panel) |
|---|---|---|
| `colorPrimary` | `#1F3D34` | Buttons, app bar, wordmark |
| `colorPrimaryPressed` | `#16281F` | Pressed state |
| `colorOnPrimary` | `#F5F1E8` | Text on primary |
| `colorAccent` | `#C98A3E` | CTA, insight, saved bookmark |
| `colorOnAccent` | `#241C0D` | Text on accent |
| `colorSecondary` | `#7C8B6F` | Tags, chips, synchronizing |
| `colorSurfaceBg` | `#F2EFE7` | General background ("paper") |
| `colorSurfaceElevated` | `#FBF9F4` | Cards, bubbles, sheets |
| `colorBorder` | `#E1DACB` | Dividers, borders |
| `colorTextPrimary` | `#241F19` | Main text |
| `colorTextSecondary` | `#6B6255` | Secondary text |
| `colorError` | `#B3402A` | Errors, destructive action |
| `colorSuccess` | `#4C6B4F` | Synchronized, confirmations |
| `colorWarningSync` | `#C98A3E` | "Synchronizing" badge |
| `colorInfoOffline` | `#5C7A93` | Offline banner — single use |

Other colors that appear on specific screens but not in the panel: user chat bubble `#D9DFD3`; text on category chips `#3F4A38`.

### Typography
| Token | Font · weight · size/line-height | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `textDisplayLg` | Fraunces 600 · 32/38 | Splash wordmark |
| `textHeadlineMd` | Fraunces 600 · 24/30 | Section titles |
| `textTitleLg` | Karla 700 · 20/26 | App bar title |
| `textTitleSm` | Karla 700 · 16/22 | Subtitles |
| `textBodyLg` | Karla 400 · 16/24 | Bubbles, entries |
| `textBodyMd` | Karla 400 · 14/20 | Secondary text and descriptions |
| `textLabelMd` | Karla 500 · 13/18 | Button text, chips |
| `textMonoCaption` | IBM Plex Mono 500 · 12/16 · letter-spacing .2 | Technical metadata (timestamps, counters, status labels) |

### Spacing (4 dp grid)
`spacingXs` 4 · `spacingSm` 8 · `spacingMd` 16 · `spacingLg` 24 · `spacingXl` 32 · `spacing2xl` 48 (dp).

### Radii
`radiusSm` 8 dp (inputs, chips) · `radiusMd` 16 dp (cards, bubbles) · `radiusLg` 24 dp (sheets, modals) · `radiusFull` 999 dp (avatars, pills).

### Elevation
`elevation1` — `0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)` (cards at rest) · `elevation2` — `0 4px 16px rgba(36,31,25,.14)` (sheets, modals).

### Icons
Phosphor library, Regular style, 24 dp: `list`, `plus`, `magnifying-glass`, `funnel`, `bookmark-simple`, `microphone`, `camera`, `gear`, `kanban`, `notebook`, `fingerprint`, `lightbulb` (and others used on specific screens: `check`, `warning-circle`, `wifi-slash`, `circle-notch`, `caret-left`, `download-simple`, `pencil-simple`, `x`, `stop`, `image`, `check-circle`, `chart-line-up`, `backspace`, `lock-key`, `paper-plane-tilt`, `chat-circle-text`).

### Spine (colored bar on the left of a card) — 3 contexts
1. Proactive insight in the chat — ochre.
2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
3. Kanban column in "Planos de Ação" — color by column **[ext]**.

### Micro-animations and transitions
- `scrimIn` (0.18 s ease-out): fade of the darkened background when any overlay opens.
- `sheetUp` (0.2 s ease-out): bottom sheets (insertion modal, filter, export) rise from the bottom of the screen.
- Continuous spinner (`spin`, 1 s linear infinite) in every loading state.
- Text streaming: the AI response is revealed progressively, with a blinking cursor at the end while it is "typing".
- PIN: after the 4th digit, a 350 ms pause before navigating.

---

## 4. Special states that need extra care

- **Expired session:** an overlay on the chat that keeps history and scroll position — the expired token must not discard the conversation state in memory before re-authentication. Re-authenticating goes back to the Biometria screen, not to a full form.
- **Offline:** blocks **sending new messages** (send icon disabled, explanatory banner), but **history stays visible and navigable**. The prototype does not show what happens to the insertion modal (text/audio/photo) when offline.
- **Asynchronous processing — audio transcription:** a loading state (spinner + frozen waveform) and two outcomes (success/error); the error always offers "Tentar novamente" and never loses the recorded audio.
- **Asynchronous processing — photo OCR:** same pattern as audio, with one extra exit on error: "Salvar só a foto", which saves the record even without extracted text.
- **Asynchronous processing — export:** two loading stages (preparing → generating the AI summary) before the result; on error, the raw data is always available for download — the failure is isolated to the AI narrative, never to the user's data.
- **Dashboard narrative unavailable:** the chart loads normally but the AI summary paragraph fails — distinct from "zero entries" (lack of data) and needs its own error message.

---

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

---

## 6. Component library

| Component | Where it appears | Variations |
|---|---|---|
| Primary button | Auth, modals, sheets, confirmations | normal (`#1F3D34`) · pressed (`#16281F`, darker) · disabled (`#E1DACB` background, `#6B6255` text) |
| Secondary button (outline) | "Tentar novamente", "Cancelar", "Baixar dados brutos" | `#1F3D34` outline, no fill |
| Text button (ghost) | Mode-toggle links, "Fechar", "Limpar" | no background, `#1F3D34` or `#6B6255` depending on context |
| Text field | Login, Texto tab, name editing | empty · focused (1.5px `#1F3D34` border) · error (`#B3402A` border) |
| Chat bubble | Home/Chat | user (light green, straight bottom-right corner) · AI (ivory with shadow, straight bottom-left corner) · streaming (pulsing cursor at the end of the text) |
| Insight card | Home/Chat | ochre spine, mono label "INSIGHT", dismiss button |
| Bookmark button (RF10) | User messages in the chat | idle (outline) · saving (spinner) · saved (ochre check) · error (red warning) |
| Send-error banner | Home/Chat | "Não foi possível enviar — toque para tentar novamente"; background `rgba(179,64,42,.08)`, warning icon, red text |
| Offline banner | Home/Chat | blue-gray background `#5C7A93`, `ph-wifi-slash` icon, light text |
| Sync badge | Record cards (Tela 4) | synced (green dot) · synchronizing (ochre dot) · sync error (red dot) |
| Filter chip | Filter sheet, active filters | single choice (date) · multiple choice (category, type) · removable with "x" (active filters) |
| Record card | Tela 4 | spine colored by origin (manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre) |
| Kanban card **[ext]** | Planos de Ação | spine by column (to do / in progress / done) |
| Initials avatar | Side menu, Configurações | dark green circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, two sizes (40px in the menu, 52px in Configurações) |
| AI persona card **[ext]** | Configurações | not selected (thin border) · selected (thick `#1F3D34` border + check icon) |
| Bar chart (dashboard) | Configurações | populated (10 bars) · one bar · empty (placeholder icon) |
| Export status card | Tela 4 (bottom sheet) | pending · processing · done · error · empty |
| Confirmation dialog | Sessão expirada, Confirmar exclusão | background scrim + centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive deletion) |
| PIN keypad | Tela 0.1b/c | digits 0–9 + backspace; progress dots above |
| Tab bar | Insertion modal | 3 tabs (Texto/Áudio/Foto), active tab with filled background |
| Audio waveform | Insertion modal, Áudio tab | active/animated (recording) · frozen and faded (processing) |
| Skeleton | Any content loaded over the network | shown for calls longer than 300 ms (RNF01) |
